findings.source_quote: Paul wrote, But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned –1 Corinthians 2:14. Men of faith, are men whose lives are governed by spiritual realities that are incomprehensible to the natural man. If you will be a man of faith, expect to be misunderstood. You are embarking on a journey that will run counter to the world view of many.
